title: KeonEnvelope
description: Canonical MCP Gateway response envelope for Keon tool calls (S8, contract-first for S8-S13). Contract fields are camelCase (correlationId, policyHash); the FUTURE S8 adapter maps them to the snake_case gateway wire form (correlation_id, policy_hash) — never the contracts. isError mirrors the MCP CallToolResult boolean from the marketops-mcp tool surface. The gateway names the producing tool in `tool` (today the transport exposes docs_as_marketing_review; Keon tools arrive as keon.* — e.g. keon.policy.check.v1, keon.browseahead.scan.v1). correlationId threads into MarketOps receipts as correlationId (PublishPacket.correlationId). Policy denial is status=denied with denial fields (mirrors GateResult); transport failure is isError=true; effect-bearing paths fail closed on either.

correlationId.description: Gateway id for this call. Threaded into MarketOps receipts as correlationId; every downstream receipt cites it.

tool.description: Keon gateway tool that produced this envelope, e.g. keon.policy.check.v1, keon.browseahead.scan.v1.

ok.description: True iff status is ok. Gateway-level success; distinct from transport isError.

status.description: Outcome class: ok (authorized), denied (policy denial, denial fields required), error (transport/effect failure, fail-closed for effect-bearing paths).

policyDecision.description: Native BioStack PolicyDecision on the HTTP wire (PolicyGateEndpoints.DecisionString). REQUIRED: 'status' is derived from this field via the documented mapping, never substituted for it.

status.description: DERIVED gateway decision: allowed/allowed-with-disclaimer -> authorize; blocked -> deny; rewrite-required/escalate-to-provider-review -> require-review. Must equal the mapping for the accompanying policyDecision (enforced below).

value.description: Policy content hash. Zeroed-hash markers ('unanchored-local', 'local-classifier-v0', 'ERROR') are never real policy versions and never accompany an anchored keon:// receipt.

version.description: Policy version, e.g. claim-policy.v1. Every zeroed-hash marker carries version '0.0.0' (marker identity lives in the value, never the version).

result.description: Tool-specific result payload on authorize/require-review. Absent on denials and errors. For allowed-with-disclaimer outcomes the disclaimer text travels here; the durable disclaimer record lives on the KeonDecision receipt shape.

denialCode.description: Machine-readable denial code. Required when decision.policyDecision is blocked (mirrors GateResult.denialCode).

denialMessage.description: Human-readable denial summary. Required when decision.policyDecision is blocked (mirrors GateResult.denialMessage).

failureStage.description: Pipeline stage that failed (mirrors the GateResult.failureStage enum).

receipts.description: Decision/scan receipt URIs evidencing this call: keon://receipt/{id} when Keon-anchored, otherwise a distinct local unanchored scheme (never keon://). Mirrors DecisionReceipt.ReceiptUri.

isError.description: Mirrors the MCP CallToolResult isError boolean from the marketops-mcp tool surface (unknown_tool, invalid_input, llm_failure, ...). Transport-level failure; distinct from policy denial (status denied, ok false, isError false).
